There are in all 102 possible initials, including the empty one.

An ''initial-pair'' is an initial cluster that consist of exactly two consonants. 

An ''affricate'' pair is one of '''tc''', '''ts''', '''dj''', '''dz'''.

A ''consonant'' is a ''voiced'' consonant, an ''unvoiced'' consonant or a ''syllabic'' consonant.

A ''voiced'' consonant is one of '''b''', '''d''', '''g''', '''j''', '''v''', '''z'''.

An ''unvoiced'' consonant is one of '''c''', '''f''', '''k''', '''p''', '''s''', '''t''', '''x'''.

A ''syllabic'' consonant is one of '''l''', '''m''', '''n''', '''r'''.

'''l''' is zero or more [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] and 'l' or 'L', not followed by '''h''' or '''l'''.

'''m''' is zero or more [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] and 'm' or 'M', not followed by '''h''' or '''m''' or '''z'''.

'''n''' is zero or more [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] and 'n' or 'N', not followed by '''h''' or '''n''' or an ''affricate''.

'''r''' is zero or more [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] and 'r' or 'R'.not followed by '''h''' or '''r'''.

'''f''' is zero or more [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] and 'f' or 'F', not followed by '''h''' or '''f''' or any ''voiced'' consonant.

'''p''' is zero or more [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] and 'p' or 'P', not followed by '''p''' or '''P''' or any ''voiced'' consonant.

'''t''' is zero or more [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] and 't' or 'T', not followed by '''h''' or '''t''' or any ''voiced'' consonant.

'''k''' is zero or more [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] and 'k' or 'K', not followed by '''h''' or '''k''' or '''x''' or any ''voiced'' consonant.

'''x''' is zero or more [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] and 'x' or 'X', not followed by '''h''' or '''x''' or '''k''' or '''c''' or any ''voiced'' consonant.

'''c''' is zero or more [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] and 'c' or 'C', not followed by '''h''' or '''c''' or '''s''' or '''x''' or any ''voiced'' consonant.

'''s''' is zero or more [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] and 's' or 'S', not followed by '''h''' or '''s''' or '''c''' or any ''voiced'' consonant.

'''j''' is zero or more [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] and 'j' or 'J', not followed by '''h''' or '''j''' or '''z''' or any '''unvoiced''' consonant.

'''z''' is zero or more [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] and 'z' or 'Z', not followed by '''h''' or '''z''' or '''j''' or any ''unvoiced'' consonant.

'''b''' is zero or more [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] and 'b' or 'B', not followed by '''h''' or '''b''' or any ''unvoiced'' consonant.

'''d''' is zero or more [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] and 'd' or 'D', not followed by '''h''' or '''d''' or any ''unvoiced'' consonant.

'''g''' is zero or more [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] and 'g' or 'G', not followed by '''h''' or '''g''' or any ''unvoiced'' consonant.

'''v''' is zero or more [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] and 'v' or 'V', not followed by '''h''' or '''v''' or any ''unvoiced'' consonant.

'''h''' is zero or more [[Morphology: special characters|commas]] and ' ' ' or 'h', followed by a [[Morphology: syllables|nucleus]].
